column1: # gate-policy.tsv — the online specs each gate-map.tsv class requires.
# Format: <class> TAB <tokens> [TAB <advisory>]. `#` starts a comment line. Tokens are
# space-separated: a canonical online spec (`gates.sh --online-spec-set`), ALL (every
# canonical spec), ANY (at least one online spec, the cheapest), or - (none). The optional
# advisory is printed on stderr whenever a changed file falls in that class.
# Every class gate-map.tsv names must appear here (Rust gate in fixture_gates.rs).
# An online spec file's own edit requires that spec alone: a spec change cannot move the
# product code the other specs exercise.
